project_name: Biraajo by Vidip Shah - Premium Personal Chef
design_vision: Cinematic, candle-lit supper-club scene. Heritage meets contemporary fine dining. High-contrast editorial layout with deep moody shadows, rich saturation, and food-photography film grain feel.

components.hero: Full-screen minimum h-screen. Dark gradient overlay at the bottom to transition into content. Large typography, asymmetric placement of name and positioning statement.

buttons.primary: bg-[#9C3527] text-[#F3EFE7] hover:bg-[#D9772B] hover:text-[#0A0504] transition-all duration-300 px-6 py-3 rounded-none tracking-wide text-sm font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2D1D1A] text-[#F3EFE7] hover:bg-[#2D1D1A] transition-all duration-300 px-6 py-3 rounded-none tracking-wide text-sm

components.cards: Flat solid surfaces (#140A09), subtle inner borders (1px border-[#2D1D1A]), no drop shadows, clean geometric lines.
components.navigation: Crystal glass effect for sticky header. bg-[#0A0504]/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#2D1D1A]. Links hover to accent_secondary.
components.forms: Shadcn components heavily customized. Dark inputs: bg-[#140A09] border border-[#2D1D1A] text-[#F3EFE7] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#9C3527].
components.masonry_gallery: Use dense grid layouts, span-varying image containers. Object-cover. Hover opacity change for interaction.

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for premium momentum feel.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Framer motion staggered fade-up for grid items. Use slow ease-out transitions (duration: 0.8s).
motion_and_interactions.hover: Images scale slightly on hover (scale 1.05) inside hidden overflow containers.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text elements overlaying images MUST use background overlays (rgba black) or heavy text-shadow to ensure WCAG AA contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a high-end, editorial hybrid platform (landing page + CMS). Do not use generic purple/blue tech gradients. Strictly adhere to the warm, dark garnet/terracotta palette. Use Cormorant Garamond for elegant, large, tightly tracked headlines. Employ heavy grain/noise textures as an overlay on dark background sections. Images MUST be utilized exactly from the provided media_urls list—no placeholders. Admin dashboard should follow a bento grid structure, utilizing the exact same dark theme and UI language (no switching to a light theme for the dashboard). Wrap interactive lists with framer-motion for smooth staggered reveals.
